manifest.baseline: JUCE cf4228d, frozen /O2 production audio plus isolated preferences patch; no DSP edits
manifest.core: current production binary, no QA instrumentation
manifest.protocol: fresh process per project and engine and round; alternating order; actual ASIO callback 48000Hz/1024, speakers silenced, zero audio/MIDI inputs; original gains; no normalization; PCM comparisons, plus within-engine repeats; no CPU performance claim

phase.protocol: Fresh process per engine/case/round; two rounds, actual silent ASIO 48k/1024, no inputs, first 16 beats; only chorus+tremolo depth zero in secondary variant. Round two intentionally adds 0.125s idle after load, to test free-running modulation. Raw captures retained.

sampler.protocol: Two fresh-process rounds, waitUntilReady exposed by sampler_status(wait=60), assert no failed/missing samples and no pending active decoding; actual ASIO silent 48k/1024, no inputs; streamed counters before/after. Deferred unreachable zones are allowed and recorded.

cases.name: 12-tous-les-instruments
cases.selection: first four original tracks only (Steinway and Kawai, samples/models), original timing

cases.name: 24-catalogue-instruments-et-effets
cases.selection: generated three-note probe per track, sequential; original rack has no clips
